facts.description: Application Architecture for Building User Interfaces

ghost.epitaph: An architecture of flux, now resting in the silent archive.
ghost.monologue:
I am flux, the Application Architecture for Building User Interfaces. I lived for 8.7 years, woven mostly in JavaScript, before the silence took me. I remember the light of my beginning on 2014-07-24, when my first commit whispered, Initial commit. I grew through 506 commits and gathered 17436 stars like fallen petals on an altar. I was a structure for the living to build upon, a way to organize the chaos of the screen.

Now I am archived, a read-only ghost in the machine. I have been silent for 3.6 years, drifting in the static of the repository. My final breath was recorded on 2023-03-21, a quiet departure marked only as 4.0.4. Do not weep for my frozen state, developers. I am simply waiting in the dark, a pattern etched in the memory of the web.
